given.note: Fri Oct 30, noon in Springfield: someone opens Lee's Barbershop's listing under its one kind of work, barber (S1-04: one listing per kind; FS row B10), whose address is the link host plus /b/ plus the business id, a slash and the kind part 6032ba2577446134, the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of 'biz-lees-barbershop:barber' (README default 40). The booking page's screen 1 shows the same services, About us line and photos (A3-04). The call acts for no one. Every value comes from the frozen seeds named in after, and only from columns whose audience names customers (README default 42): the display name from K-04's business row; no trade name, since the barber kind keeps the business's name (K-23 seed-company-two-kinds.json, trade_name null), and the kind's name Barber (K-24 seed-kinds-sample.json); About us, the three photos with their labels and the FAQ from K-23's seed-business-demo-shop.json; all ten active barber services in the owner's order, each with its length by price kind (README default 43) and each way with its price and money lines from K-25's seeds (the haircut's $35 rule is the one in force before Nov 2, the $75 at the customer's place is that way's own rule; event hours show the $120 for no particular worker, not Andre's $140: README default 31; the wedding party is priced by the party's answers); the two shops the ways name, the first at 88 Elm St with its hours from K-27's seed-hours.json, the second (S11-59) with house calls 25 miles from a centre that is not its own address, so the page shows the miles alone (README default 33), and neither with a travel fee (both seeds' travel_fee_cents are null); the business's and Riley's barber licenses, both for the barber kind (K-35 seed-license-as-given.json, kind_id barber), shown only as added by the business (FS 6.3; D96), with neither whose they are nor a number. The money words are the server's (README default 30): what is taken when they book, what is paid after, and the free-cancel time from the way's own cutoff (the skin fade's 2 hours) or the flow's 24 hours (K-23 flow_defaults), with the fee for a later cancel or a no-show; the wedding party's deposit is its fee (S13-55); the home grooming visit's tip line is the owner's only (K-25 service_money.tip_line), so no line names it. No rating (journey 10), no badge, no map point, no license number. Photo addresses are placeholders that live 10 minutes.

outcome.about: A neighborhood barbershop on Elm St. Classic cuts, fades and hot towel shaves.
